title.en: Volume 427 Biographies 214: Wang Yide, Ceng Wangyan, Jue Luo Qi Ling, Fu Ji, Weng Tongshu, Yan Shusen
title.raw: 卷427 列傳二百十四 王懿德 曾望颜 觉罗耆龄 福济 翁同书 严树森

sentences.zh: 列傳二百十四

translations.literal: Biographies two hundred fourteen
translations.idiomatic: Biography 214

sentences.zh: 王懿德，字紹甫，河南祥符人。

translations.literal: Wang Yide, style name Shaofu, was a native of Xiangfu in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yide, whose courtesy name was Shaofu, came from Xiangfu in Henan.

sentences.zh: 道光三年進士，授禮部主事，再遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daoguang he became a jinshi, was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Rites, and was promoted again to director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the third year of the Daoguang reign and was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Rites before being promoted again to director.

sentences.zh: 出為湖北襄陽知府，擢山東兗沂曹濟道。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as prefect of Xiangyang in Hubei and was promoted to intendant of the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as prefect of Xiangyang in Hubei, then promoted to intendant of the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 歷山東鹽運使、浙江按察使，調山東。

translations.literal: He served successively as salt transport commissioner of Shandong and surveillance commissioner of Zhejiang, then was transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He held the posts of Shandong salt transport commissioner and Zhejiang surveillance commissioner in turn before being transferred back to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 三十年，擢陝西布政使。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was promoted to provincial treasurer of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In his thirtieth year of service he was promoted to provincial treasurer of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，護巡撫，奏請豁免積年民欠常平倉糧八萬餘石，擢福建巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he acted as governor, memorialized requesting exemption of more than eighty thousand dan of grain owed by the people over many years from the ever-normal granaries, and was promoted to governor of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng he served as acting governor and memorialized to waive more than eighty thousand dan of grain that commoners had owed for years to the ever-normal granaries; he was then promoted to governor of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 二年，奏言：「漢患錢乏，造幣贍國；

translations.literal: In the second year he memorialized, saying: "The Han dreaded a shortage of coin and minted currency to support the state;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he submitted a memorial that began: "The Han worried about a lack of cash and coined money to sustain the state;

sentences.zh: 宋有交引、錢引、交鈔；

translations.literal: the Song had jiaoyin, qianyin, and jiaochao;
translations.idiomatic: the Song issued jiaoyin, qianyin, and jiaochao;

sentences.zh: 元、明製鈔法，或直千文、五百不等。

translations.literal: the Yuan and Ming instituted paper-note laws, with denominations equivalent to one thousand or five hundred cash, and so forth.
translations.idiomatic: the Yuan and Ming established paper-note systems with denominations worth as much as one thousand or five hundred cash, among others.

sentences.zh: 我朝準歲入為出，因民利而利，帑項夙充，奚庸過慮？

translations.literal: Our dynasty measures expenditures by annual revenue, profits where the people profit—the treasury has long been full; why worry excessively?
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty matches spending to yearly income and seeks profit only where the people profit; the treasury has long been ample—why fret needlessly?

sentences.zh: 自海防多事，銷費漸增，粵西軍務，河工撥款，不下千數百萬，目前已艱，善後何術？

translations.literal: Since coastal defense has seen many troubles, spending has gradually increased; military affairs in western Guangdong and allocations for river works amount to no less than tens of millions—already strained at present—what method for aftermath?
translations.idiomatic: Since coastal defense grew troubled, expenditures have steadily risen; western Guangdong campaigns and river-work appropriations run to many millions, and funds are already tight—what remedy is there for the aftermath?

sentences.zh: 捐輸雖殷，僅同勺水。

translations.literal: Though voluntary contributions are abundant, they are merely like a ladleful of water.
translations.idiomatic: Even generous voluntary donations are no more than a spoonful poured into a great vat.

sentences.zh: 督催稍迫，且礙閭閻。

translations.literal: If supervision and urging are slightly pressing, they also obstruct the lanes and alleys.
translations.idiomatic: Press the levies too hard and you only harm ordinary households in lane and alley alike.

sentences.zh: 與其籌畫多銀，不若改行鈔引。

translations.literal: Rather than planning for much silver, it is better to switch to issuing paper notes.
translations.idiomatic: Rather than scheming for ever more silver, we should switch to circulating paper notes.

sentences.zh: 歷考畿輔、山左以及關東，多用錢票，即福建各屬，銀錢番票參互行使，便於攜取，視同現金，商民亦操紙幣信用。

translations.literal: Examining throughout the metropolitan region, Shandong, and the northeast, they widely use money notes; even in the various prefectures of Fujian, silver, cash, and foreign notes circulate in combination, convenient to carry, regarded as equivalent to ready cash—the merchants and populace also place credit in paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: A survey of the capital region, Shandong, and the northeast shows widespread use of money notes; even in Fujian's subordinate districts silver, cash, and foreign bills circulate side by side, easy to carry and treated like ready money, and merchants and commoners already trust paper currency.

sentences.zh: 況天下之主，國庫​​之重，飭造寶鈔，尤易流轉。

translations.literal: Moreover, as sovereign of all under Heaven and with the weight of the national treasury, ordering the manufacture of imperial treasure notes would be especially easy to circulate.
translations.idiomatic: How much more so for the sovereign of the realm and the weight of the national treasury: imperial treasure notes, once ordered struck, would circulate all the more readily.

sentences.zh: 惟鈔式宜簡，一兩為率，頒發籓庫，通喻四民，準完丁糧關稅，自無窒滯。

translations.literal: Only the note form should be simple, taking one tael as the standard, issued through provincial treasuries, communicated to the four classes of people, permitted for completing land tax and customs duties—then there will naturally be no obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: The note design should stay simple, with one tael as the standard, issued through provincial treasuries and explained to all four classes of society; allow them for land tax and customs, and circulation will not stall.

sentences.zh: 或疑庫銀溢出，悉成鈔引，銀日以少，鈔日以賤。

translations.literal: Some may suspect that when treasury silver overflows and all becomes paper notes, silver daily grows less and notes daily grow cheap.
translations.idiomatic: Some fear that if treasury silver pours out and everything turns into notes, silver will dwindle day by day and notes depreciate.

sentences.zh: 豈知朝廷不蓄為寶，以天下之財供天下之用，能收能發，自能左右逢源也。」

translations.literal: How would they know that the court does not hoard as treasure, but supplies the needs of all under Heaven with the wealth of all under Heaven—able to receive and able to disburse, it can naturally find resources wherever it turns?"
translations.idiomatic: They do not understand that the court does not hoard treasure for its own sake but applies the empire's wealth to the empire's needs; able both to take in and to pay out, it can always find a way through."

sentences.zh: 疏入，諭軍機大臣同戶部議行。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, the throne instructed the Grand Council and the Board of Revenue jointly to deliberate and implement it.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the throne ordered the Grand Council and the Board of Revenue to deliberate and carry it out.

sentences.zh: 兼署閩浙總督。

translations.literal: He concurrently served as acting governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He also served as acting governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 三年，奏福建匪徒糾結滋擾，請寬地方官失察處分，俾獲盜自贖，允之。

translations.literal: In the third year he memorialized that bandits in Fujian were gathering and causing increasing disturbances, requesting leniency in punishments for local officials' failure to detect them, so that catching bandits might redeem their faults—this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he reported that bandits in Fujian were banding together and growing bolder, and asked that penalties on local officials for lax surveillance be eased so that capturing robbers could redeem their faults; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 時會匪四起，突入海澄縣劫獄戕官，又掠同安、安溪，遣兵會剿。

translations.literal: At the time secret-society bandits rose everywhere; they suddenly entered Haicheng county, raided the jail and killed officials, and also plundered Tong'an and Anxi—troops were dispatched for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Secret-society rebels were rising on every side; they burst into Haicheng county, stormed the jail and killed officials, then raided Tong'an and Anxi, and troops were sent for a joint campaign.

sentences.zh: 漳州猝為匪陷，鎮、道皆遇害。

translations.literal: Zhangzhou was suddenly seized by bandits; the garrison commander and circuit intendant were both killed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangzhou fell suddenly to the rebels, and both the garrison commander and the circuit intendant were killed.

sentences.zh: 游擊饒廷選方率兵他出，聞警回援。

translations.literal: Ranger Raotingxuan was just leading troops elsewhere; hearing the alarm, he returned to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: Ranger Raotingxuan was away leading troops elsewhere; when he heard the alarm he turned back to reinforce the city.

sentences.zh: 近城鄉民及城中紳士密約，啟廷選入，擒匪首謝厚等，殲匪數百，復其城。

translations.literal: Country folk near the city and gentry within the city made a secret pact, admitted Raotingxuan, captured bandit chiefs Xie Hou and others, destroyed several hundred bandits, and recovered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Villagers near the city and gentry inside it made a secret pact, let Raotingxuan in, seized the rebel leaders Xie Hou and others, killed several hundred bandits, and recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 延平亦被匪攻，副將李壽春擊走之。

translations.literal: Yanping was also attacked by bandits; vice commander Li Shouchun drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Yanping came under attack as well; Vice Commander Li Shouchun beat the rebels back.

sentences.zh: 大田、德化有匪闌入，紳士率鄉團殺賊數百。

translations.literal: In Datian and Dehua bandits intruded; gentry led local militia and killed several hundred bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits broke into Datian and Dehua; local gentry led militia and killed several hundred of them.

sentences.zh: 永春為匪所踞，游擊恩霈等會勇破賊，擒其渠，餘黨遁走，被詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: Yongchun was occupied by bandits; ranger En Pei and others joined braves to rout the bandits, captured their leaders, and the remnant faction fled—he received an imperial commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchun was held by rebels until Ranger En Pei and others joined local braves, routed the bandits, captured their chiefs, and drove the rest away; he received an imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 台灣南路亦有匪擾，懿德奏陳防剿情形，諭曰：「福建紳練素諳大義。

translations.literal: Bandits also disturbed the southern route in Taiwan; Yide memorialized the situation of defense and suppression. The edict said: "Fujian's gentry and militia have long understood righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels also harassed southern Taiwan; Yide reported on defense and suppression. An edict read: "The gentry and militia of Fujian have always understood what is right.

sentences.zh: 前同安縣義民殺賊，泉州在籍副將呂大升等自原募勇渡台，是其明驗。

translations.literal: Previously righteous commoners of Tong'an county killed bandits; retired vice commander Lü Dasheng of Quanzhou and others volunteered to recruit braves and cross to Taiwan—this is clear proof.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, righteous men of Tong'an county killed bandits, and retired Vice Commander Lü Dasheng of Quanzhou and others volunteered to raise troops and cross to Taiwan—clear proof of their spirit.

sentences.zh: 務當激揚士氣，滅此群醜。」

translations.literal: You must stir up morale and destroy this pack of villains."
translations.idiomatic: You must rouse their morale and destroy this pack of villains."

sentences.zh: 尋以海澄、同安、廈門、安溪、仙遊相繼陷，疏請治罪，下吏議。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Haicheng, Tong'an, Xiamen, Anxi, and Xianyou fell in succession; he memorialized requesting punishment, and the matter was referred to the judicial authorities for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Haicheng, Tong'an, Xiamen, Anxi, and Xianyou fell one after another; he memorialized asking that officials be punished, and the case was sent to the judicial authorities.

sentences.zh: 令參將李煌、都司顧飛熊破賊，尤溪縣城失而旋复。

translations.literal: He ordered participation commander Li Huang and battalion commander Gu Feixiong to rout the bandits; Youxi county seat was lost but soon recovered.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Participation Commander Li Huang and Battalion Commander Gu Feixiong to defeat the rebels; Youxi county town was lost but quickly retaken.

sentences.zh: 水師提督施得高、金門鎮總兵孫鼎鼇擊賊於金門，破之。

translations.literal: Naval commander Shidegao and Jinmen garrison commander Sun Ding'ao attacked bandits at Jinmen and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Naval Commander Shidegao and Jinmen Garrison Commander Sun Ding'ao attacked the rebels at Jinmen and broke them.

sentences.zh: 廈門、仙遊皆复。

translations.literal: Xiamen and Xianyou were both recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Xiamen and Xianyou were both recovered.

sentences.zh: 四年，上游以次定，賊首林俊尚焚斃，實授閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the upper reaches were settled in sequence; the bandit chief Lin Junshang was burned to death; he was formally appointed governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the upper districts were pacified in turn; the rebel chief Lin Junshang died in a fire; Yide was formally appointed governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 戶部議限制行鈔，奏言：「鈔之能行，不在於發而在於收。

translations.literal: The Board of Revenue deliberated on restricting the circulation of notes; he memorialized, saying: "Whether notes can circulate lies not in issuance but in redemption.
translations.idiomatic: When the Board of Revenue debated limiting note circulation, he memorialized: "Notes circulate not because they are issued but because they are redeemed.

sentences.zh: 內自部庫以及各關稅務，外則丁耗錢糧、鹽典契紙各稅，果能悉收鈔票，不限成數，且示以非鈔不用，則百姓爭相買鈔。

translations.literal: Internally from the ministry treasury and all customs offices, externally land tax with surcharges, salt monopoly, deeds, and all taxes—if they could all accept notes without limiting the proportion, and show that nothing but notes would be accepted, the common people would compete to buy notes.
translations.idiomatic: From the ministry treasury and every customs office inward, and from land tax, salt monopoly, deed duties, and all other levies outward, if the state would accept notes in full without quota and make clear that nothing but notes would do, the people would rush to buy them.

sentences.zh: 有銀之家，以鈔輕而易藏；

translations.literal: Households with silver would find notes light and easy to store;
translations.idiomatic: Households that hold silver would find notes light and easy to store;

sentences.zh: 納課之氓，以率定而無損；

translations.literal: tax-paying commoners would find the fixed standard without loss;
translations.idiomatic: taxpayers would face a fixed standard without loss;

sentences.zh: 貿遷之商，以利運而省費。

translations.literal: merchants engaged in trade would profit from easy transport and save expense.
translations.idiomatic: merchants would profit from easy transport and lower costs.

sentences.zh: 部臣見未及此，惟恐解鈔而不解銀，故限以成數。

translations.literal: The ministry officials had not seen this far; they only feared accepting notes but not silver, hence they limited the proportion.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry had not seen so far; fearing that notes would be taken in but silver refused, they capped the proportion.

sentences.zh: 夫以為無用，則鈔、銀均非可食可衣；

translations.literal: If regarded as useless, then both notes and silver are equally not edible or wearable;
translations.idiomatic: If you call them useless, neither notes nor silver can be eaten or worn;

sentences.zh: 以為有用，則鈔、銀不能畸輕畸重。

translations.literal: if regarded as useful, then notes and silver cannot be unevenly light or heavy.
translations.idiomatic: if you call them useful, notes and silver cannot be valued unequally.

sentences.zh: 今於領鈔之時，區以一省，由部知照，方能行用。

translations.literal: Now at the time of receiving notes, they are confined to one province and require notification from the ministry before they can be used.
translations.idiomatic: Today, when notes are issued, they are confined to one province and require ministry notice before they may circulate.

sentences.zh: 己不自信，人豈可強？

translations.literal: If one does not trust oneself, how can others be compelled?
translations.idiomatic: If the state lacks confidence in its own notes, how can the people be forced to accept them?

sentences.zh: 徒開藉端漁利之門。

translations.literal: This merely opens a door for pretexts to profit at others' expense.
translations.idiomatic: This only opens a door for pretexts and profiteering.

sentences.zh: 請飭部臣及各省督撫，以此發即以此收，無論各項度支，示天下非鈔不用。

translations.literal: He requested that ministry officials and governors-general and governors of all provinces issue and redeem with the same notes, regardless of all items of expenditure, showing the empire that nothing but notes would be accepted.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that ministry officials and every governor-general and governor issue and redeem with the same notes, for every item of expenditure, and show the empire that nothing but notes would be accepted.

sentences.zh: 新收買鈔銀兩，積於部庫、籓庫，以為母金。

translations.literal: The silver taels newly received from purchasing notes would accumulate in the ministry and provincial treasuries as reserve capital.
translations.idiomatic: The silver taels received in exchange for notes would pile up in the ministry and provincial treasuries as reserve capital.

sentences.zh: 行鈔不分畛域，則銀日豐而本源厚​​。」

translations.literal: If notes circulate without regard to boundaries, silver daily grows abundant and the source thickens."
translations.idiomatic: If notes circulate without regard to provincial boundaries, silver will grow more plentiful day by day and the monetary foundation will deepen."

sentences.zh: 疏入，下部議，格不行。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, it was referred to the ministry for deliberation and blocked from implementation.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, it was sent to the ministry for deliberation and was blocked from taking effect.

sentences.zh: 五年，因病請改京職，不許。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, citing illness he requested transfer to a capital post; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he asked, on grounds of illness, to be moved to a capital post; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 七年，粵匪自江西竄入境，陷光澤、汀州，尋先後克復。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Guangdong rebels from Jiangxi slipped into the province, seized Guangze and Tingzhou, and were soon recovered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Guangdong rebels slipped in from Jiangxi, took Guangze and Tingzhou, and both places were soon recovered.

sentences.zh: 遣總兵饒廷選進援浙江、江西。

translations.literal: He dispatched Major General Raotingxuan to advance and reinforce Zhejiang and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Major General Raotingxuan to reinforce Zhejiang and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 八年，京察，詔以懿德攘外安內，佈置咸宜，予議敘。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, at the capital inspection, an edict cited Yide's repelling outsiders and pacifying within, his arrangements all fitting, and granted consideration for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, at the capital inspection, an edict praised Yide for repelling foreign threats and pacifying the interior, with every arrangement well judged, and ordered him considered for promotion.

sentences.zh: 粵匪復自江西竄陷浦城、松溪、政和等縣，邵武、光澤、連城亦被賊擾。

translations.literal: Guangdong rebels again from Jiangxi seized Pucheng, Songxi, Zhenghe, and other counties; Shaowu, Guangze, and Liancheng were also harassed by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong rebels again broke in from Jiangxi and took Pucheng, Songxi, Zhenghe, and other counties, while Shaowu, Guangze, and Liancheng also came under attack.

sentences.zh: 週天培軍赴援，賊復回竄江西，諸城皆复。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianpei's army went to reinforce; the bandits again slipped back into Jiangxi, and all the cities were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Tianpei's force came to reinforce; the rebels slipped back into Jiangxi, and the cities were all recovered.

sentences.zh: 十年，以病乞罷。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, citing illness he requested dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he asked to resign on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 十一年，卒，諡靖毅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he died; his posthumous title was Jingyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he died and was given the posthumous title Jingyi.

sentences.zh: 曾望顏，字瞻孔，廣東香山人。

translations.literal: Ceng Wangyan, style name Zhan Kong, was a native of Xiangshan in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Ceng Wangyan, whose courtesy name was Zhan Kong, came from Xiangshan in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 道光二年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，遷御史。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he became a jinshi, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and was promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Daoguang, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was made a compiler, and later became a censor.

sentences.zh: 十五年，條奏整飭科場凡十四事，皆如所請行。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he submitted in detail fourteen items for rectifying the examination grounds; all were carried out as requested.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he memorialized in detail fourteen measures to reform the examination system, and all were adopted as he proposed.

sentences.zh: 遷給事中，再遷光祿寺少卿。

translations.literal: He was promoted to supervising secretary, then again to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to supervising secretary and then to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 上以望顏遇事敢言，褒勉之，轉太常寺少卿。

translations.literal: The emperor, because Wangyan spoke boldly on affairs, praised and encouraged him, and transferred him to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Because Wangyan spoke boldly whenever matters arose, the emperor praised and encouraged him and moved him to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 十六年，擢順天府尹。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was promoted to prefect of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was promoted to prefect of the Shuntian metropolitan district.

sentences.zh: 二十年，出為福建布政使。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he went out to serve as provincial treasurer of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was posted as provincial treasurer of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，戶部銀庫虧帑事發，望顏嘗以御史察庫，未糾發，坐奪官分償。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Board of Revenue silver vault deficit was exposed; Wangyan had once inspected the vault as a censor but failed to report it, and was punished by dismissal and ordered to share repayment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the deficit in the Board of Revenue silver vault came to light; Wangyan had once inspected the vault as a censor but had not exposed the fraud, and was stripped of office and ordered to pay a share of restitution.

sentences.zh: 旋授主事。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed a principal clerk.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon reappointed as a principal clerk.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，命以五品京堂候補，補通政司參議。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng he was ordered to await appointment as a fifth-rank capital official and was appointed vice commissioner of the Court of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng he was ordered to await appointment as a fifth-rank capital official and was given the post of vice commissioner of the Court of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 六年，复授順天府尹，擢陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was again appointed prefect of Shuntian and was promoted to governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was again made prefect of Shuntian and then promoted to governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 七年，粵匪自湖北竹山擾陝西平利，望顏遣游擊常有等會湖北軍克竹山。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Guangdong rebels from Zhushan in Hubei harassed Pingli in Shaanxi; Wangyan dispatched ranger Chang You and others to join Hubei troops in recovering Zhushan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Guangdong rebels from Zhushan in Hubei raided Pingli in Shaanxi; Wangyan sent Ranger Chang You and others to join Hubei forces in retaking Zhushan.

sentences.zh: 賊竄均州武當山，又遣總兵龍澤厚會湖北軍進剿，殲賊殆盡。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to Wudang Mountain in Junzhou; he again dispatched Major General Long Zehou to join Hubei troops in advancing to suppress them, destroying the bandits nearly to the last man.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Wudang Mountain in Junzhou; he again sent Major General Long Zehou with Hubei troops to pursue them and nearly wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 八年，粵匪入雞頭關，侵商南，遣兵擊走之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Guangdong rebels entered Jitou Pass and invaded Shangnan; he dispatched troops and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Guangdong rebels entered Jitou Pass and invaded Shangnan; he sent troops and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 九年，署四川總督。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he acted as governor-general of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he served as acting governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 粵匪入四川，攻敘州，尋引去。

translations.literal: Guangdong rebels entered Sichuan, attacked Xuzhou, and soon withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong rebels entered Sichuan, attacked Xuzhou, and soon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 滇匪藍朝柱、李永和倡亂，與敘州土匪勾結肆擾。

translations.literal: Yunnan rebels Lan Chaozhu and Li Yonghe raised rebellion and joined with local bandits of Xuzhou to rampage.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan rebels Lan Chaozhu and Li Yonghe rose in revolt and, in league with local bandits around Xuzhou, spread havoc.

sentences.zh: 望顏遣兵進攻，斬賊目李祖資等。

translations.literal: Wangyan dispatched troops to attack and beheaded the bandit leader Li Zuzi and others.
translations.idiomatic: Wangyan sent troops against them and beheaded the rebel chieftain Li Zuzi and others.

sentences.zh: 十年，遣提督孔廣順等攻大岩尖山賊寨，獲其渠王帶週。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he dispatched Regional Commander Kong Guangshun and others to attack the bandit stockade at Dayanjian Mountain and captured its leader Wang Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he sent Regional Commander Kong Guangshun and others to storm the rebel stronghold at Dayanjian Mountain and captured its leader Wang Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 滇匪攻犍為，自箭板場竄至河口，將縛筏以渡，提督皁升督兵水陸夾擊，走之。

translations.literal: Yunnan rebels attacked Qianwei, fled from Jianban chang to Hekou, and were about to bind rafts to cross; Regional Commander Zaosheng directed troops in combined land and water attack and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan rebels attacked Qianwei, fled from Jianban chang to Hekou, and were preparing rafts to cross the river; Regional Commander Zaosheng struck them from land and water and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 望顏又慮賊渡河犯嘉定，遣總兵佔泰等截擊。

translations.literal: Wangyan also feared the bandits would cross the river and invade Jiading, and dispatched Major General Zhantai and others to intercept.
translations.idiomatic: Wangyan also feared the rebels would cross the river and strike Jiading, and sent Major General Zhantai and others to intercept them.

sentences.zh: 賊據觀音場，師自黃閣寺進攻，戰於羅城鋪，敗之。

translations.literal: The bandits held Guanyin chang; the army advanced from Huangge Temple, fought at Luocheng pu, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held Guanyin chang; government forces advanced from Huangge Temple, fought them at Luocheng pu, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 賊竄踞貢井、天池寺諸地，為壘數十，飭佔泰等剿之。

translations.literal: The bandits fled and occupied Gongjing, Tianchi Temple, and other places, building several dozen fortifications; he ordered Zhantai and others to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Gongjing, Tianchi Temple, and other places and built dozens of stockades; he ordered Zhantai and others to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 黔匪李志高等據長阡壩諸寨，遣兵攻毀長阡壩。

translations.literal: Guizhou rebels Li Zhigao and others held the stockades at Changqianba and elsewhere; he dispatched troops to attack and destroy Changqianba.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou rebels led by Li Zhigao held the stockades around Changqianba; he sent troops to attack and destroy Changqianba.

sentences.zh: 總兵虎嵩林自程家場進攻貢井，又遣兵攻濯水賊，獲其渠賀世愚等。

translations.literal: Major General Hu Songlin advanced from Chengjiachang to attack Gongjing, and again dispatched troops to attack the bandits at Zhuoshui, capturing their leaders He Shiyu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Major General Hu Songlin advanced from Chengjiachang against Gongjing and also sent troops against the rebels at Zhuoshui, capturing their chiefs He Shiyu and others.

sentences.zh: 諸路雖有斬獲，而滇匪勢日熾，藍朝柱擾青神、敘州，李永和攻嘉定，省城戒嚴。

translations.literal: Although there were kills and captures on various fronts, Yunnan rebel strength grew daily; Lan Chaozhu harassed Qingshen and Xuzhou, Li Yonghe attacked Jiading, and the provincial capital was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: Although several columns scored victories, Yunnan rebel power grew daily: Lan Chaozhu harassed Qingshen and Xuzhou, Li Yonghe attacked Jiading, and the provincial capital was placed under martial law.

sentences.zh: 詔斥望顏不能制賊，下吏議。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Wangyan for inability to control the bandits and referred the case to the judicial authorities.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked Wangyan for failing to control the rebels and referred the case to the judicial authorities.

sentences.zh: 給事中李培祜疏劾任性妄為，濫保浮銷，縱子乾預。

translations.literal: Supervising secretary Li Peihu memorialized impeaching him for willful and reckless conduct, indiscriminate recommendations and inflated expenses, and allowing his son to meddle.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Li Peihu memorialized to impeach him for willful misconduct, reckless recommendations and padded accounts, and letting his son interfere in affairs.

sentences.zh: 命陝甘總督樂斌偕署巡撫譚廷襄按治。

translations.literal: He was ordered investigated by Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Le Bin together with Acting Governor Tan Tingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Le Bin of Shaanxi and Gansu, together with Acting Governor Tan Tingxiang, were ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 覆奏望顏尚無贓私，惟舉劾屬吏多粗率謬誤，不能約束子弟僕隸。

translations.literal: Their report stated that Wangyan had no corruption as yet, but his recommendations and impeachments of subordinate officials were often crude and mistaken, and he could not restrain his sons, younger relatives, and servants.
translations.idiomatic: Their report found no corruption in Wangyan himself, but said his promotions and impeachments of subordinates were often careless and wrong, and he could not control his sons, younger kin, and servants.

sentences.zh: 部議褫職，命暫留署任。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated stripping him of office, but he was ordered to remain temporarily in his acting post.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry recommended stripping him of office, but he was ordered to remain temporarily in his acting post.

sentences.zh: 復為知府翁祖烈所訐，下將軍崇實按治，辭复連子捷魁及其僕，乃命解任，仍留四川。

translations.literal: He was again impeached by prefect Weng Zulie; General Chongshi was sent to investigate; repeated testimony implicated his son Jiekui and his servants; he was then ordered relieved of duty but remained in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was impeached again by Prefect Weng Zulie; General Chongshi was sent to investigate; repeated testimony implicated his son Jiekui and his servants; he was relieved of duty but ordered to remain in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，命回籍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was ordered to return to his native place.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was ordered to return home.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，召詣京師，以四品京堂候補。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was summoned to the capital and ordered to await appointment as a fourth-rank capital official.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he was summoned to the capital to await appointment as a fourth-rank capital official.

sentences.zh: 五年，補內閣侍讀學士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed reader in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed a reader in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九年，卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he died.

sentences.zh: 覺羅耆齡，字九峰，正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Jueluo Qiling, style name Jiufeng, was of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Jueluo Qiling, whose courtesy name was Jiufeng, belonged to the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 初授工部筆帖式，中式道光十七年舉人，升刑部主事，累遷郎中。

translations.literal: He was first appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Works, passed the provincial examination in the seventeenth year of Daoguang, was promoted to principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice, and was repeatedly promoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a clerk in the Ministry of Works, passed the provincial examination in the seventeenth year of Daoguang, rose to principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice, and was promoted repeatedly to director.

sentences.zh: 出為江西廣信知府，調南安。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as prefect of Guangxin in Jiangxi and was transferred to Nan'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as prefect of Guangxin in Jiangxi and then transferred to Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 歷署建昌、撫州、吉安、袁州諸府。

translations.literal: He served in acting capacity at the prefectures of Jianchang, Fuzhou, Ji'an, and Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as acting prefect of Jianchang, Fuzhou, Ji'an, and Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，調赴省城筦官團局。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng he was transferred to the provincial capital to manage the official militia bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng he was transferred to the provincial capital to run the official militia bureau.

sentences.zh: 粵匪攻南昌，耆齡佐守禦，賜花翎。

translations.literal: Guangdong rebels attacked Nanchang; Qiling assisted in defense and was awarded the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangdong rebels attacked Nanchang, Qiling helped defend the city and was awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 尋補贛州知府。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed prefect of Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made prefect of Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢吉南贛寧道。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to intendant of the Ji-Nan-Gan-Ning circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to intendant of the Ji-Nan-Gan-Ning circuit.

sentences.zh: 賊竄義寧，耆齡率兵赴援。

translations.literal: Bandits fled to Yining; Qiling led troops to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fled to Yining, and Qiling led troops to reinforce.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢布政使，命駐防饒州，偕畢金科等分屯扼守。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to provincial treasurer, ordered to garrison Raozhou, and together with Bi Jinke and others divided encampments to hold defensive positions.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he became provincial treasurer, was ordered to garrison Raozhou, and with Bi Jinke and others set up divided camps to hold the line.

sentences.zh: 賊三路來犯，金科乘勝追賊，而贛軍營壘被襲，城遂陷。

translations.literal: Bandits attacked on three routes; Jinke pursued the bandits in victory, but the Ganzhou army camps were raided and the city then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels attacked on three fronts; Jinke pursued them in victory, but the Ganzhou camps were overrun and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 旋即合攻破賊，復之。

translations.literal: Soon they joined forces, defeated the bandits, and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: They soon joined forces, defeated the rebels, and retook the city.

sentences.zh: 奉檄移軍南昌。

translations.literal: By order he moved his army to Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to move his army to Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 侍郎曾國籓奏：「耆齡在饒州聯絡鄉團，屏障東北。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Zeng Guofan memorialized: "Qiling at Raozhou has linked local militia, shielding the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Zeng Guofan wrote: "At Raozhou Qiling has rallied local militia and shielded the northeast.

sentences.zh: 今九江重兵已盡赴省城，耆齡宜仍駐饒州，毋庸移調。」

translations.literal: Now the heavy forces at Jiujiang have all gone to the provincial capital; Qiling should still remain at Raozhou and need not be transferred."
translations.idiomatic: Now that Jiujiang's main forces have all gone to the provincial capital, Qiling should remain at Raozhou and should not be transferred."

sentences.zh: 時江西司道多統軍，曾國籓及學政廉兆綸皆以耆齡為善，而訾議巡撫文俊。

translations.literal: At the time many Jiangxi circuit and prefectural officials commanded armies; Zeng Guofan and educational commissioner Lian Zhaolun all regarded Qiling as capable, while criticizing Governor Wen Jun.
translations.idiomatic: At the time many Jiangxi officials commanded troops; Zeng Guofan and Educational Commissioner Lian Zhaolun praised Qiling, while criticizing Governor Wen Jun.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔罷文俊，擢耆齡為巡撫。

translations.literal: In the seventh year an edict dismissed Wen Jun and promoted Qiling to governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Wen Jun was dismissed by edict and Qiling was promoted to governor.

sentences.zh: 江西郡縣半淪於賊，存者惟南昌、廣信、饒州、贛州數郡，戰事多倚湘軍。

translations.literal: Half of Jiangxi's counties and prefectures had fallen to bandits; only Nanchang, Guangxin, Raozhou, and Ganzhou among several prefectures remained, and warfare largely relied on the Hunan army.
translations.idiomatic: Half of Jiangxi's districts had fallen to rebels; only Nanchang, Guangxin, Raozhou, and Ganzhou still held out, and the fighting depended largely on the Hunan army.

sentences.zh: 未幾，曾國籓偕弟國荃以奔喪歸湖南。

translations.literal: Before long Zeng Guofan and his brother Guoquan returned to Hunan for mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zeng Guofan and his brother Guoquan went home to Hunan to mourn.

sentences.zh: 圍吉安久不下，國荃去後，軍無所統，益疲。

translations.literal: The siege of Ji'an had long failed to succeed; after Guoquan left, the army had no unified command and grew more exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: The siege of Ji'an dragged on; after Guoquan left, the army lacked unified command and grew weaker.

sentences.zh: 耆齡奏起國荃仍督吉安軍，乃復振。

translations.literal: Qiling memorialized to recall Guoquan to command the Ji'an army again, and morale revived.
translations.idiomatic: Qiling memorialized to bring Guoquan back to command the Ji'an army, and the force revived.

sentences.zh: 七月，劉騰鴻克瑞州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Liu Tenghong captured Ruizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Liu Tenghong took Ruizhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，劉長佑克臨江。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Liu Changyou captured Linjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Liu Changyou took Linjiang.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，李續賓克九江，蕭啟江、劉坤一克撫州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year Li Xubin captured Jiujiang, and Xiao Qijiang and Liu Kunyi captured Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eighth year Li Xubin took Jiujiang, while Xiao Qijiang and Liu Kunyi took Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，曾國荃克吉安。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Zeng Guoquan captured Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zeng Guoquan took Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 詔起曾國籓督師規浙江，於九月至南昌。

translations.literal: An edict recalled Zeng Guofan to command troops planning for Zhejiang; in the ninth month he arrived at Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict recalled Zeng Guofan to command operations toward Zhejiang, and he reached Nanchang in the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 國籓前於五年初至江西，兵餉俱困，地方官吏狎侮掣肘，事多艱阻。

translations.literal: When Guofan had first come to Jiangxi in the fifth year, troops and pay were both strained, local officials were familiar and obstructive, and affairs were mostly difficult.
translations.idiomatic: When Guofan had first reached Jiangxi in the fifth year, troops and funds were both strained, local officials were dismissive and obstructive, and nearly everything was difficult.

sentences.zh: 至是，耆齡奉令惟謹，主客大和，軍事日有起色。

translations.literal: By this time Qiling obeyed orders with utmost care, host and guest were in great harmony, and military affairs daily improved.
translations.idiomatic: By then Qiling obeyed every order scrupulously, civil and military leaders worked in harmony, and the campaign steadily improved.

sentences.zh: 九年三月，克南安。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year Nan'an was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year Nan'an was taken.

sentences.zh: 六月，克景德鎮。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Jingdezhen was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Jingdezhen was taken.

sentences.zh: 江西全境暫告肅清。

translations.literal: All of Jiangxi was temporarily declared pacified.
translations.idiomatic: For the moment all of Jiangxi was declared pacified.

sentences.zh: 九月，調廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he was transferred to governor of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he was transferred to governor of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 粵匪翟明開自南雄攻江西安遠，耆齡遣兵越境解圍。

translations.literal: Guangdong rebel Zhai Mingkai from Nanxiong attacked Anyuan in Jiangxi; Qiling dispatched troops across the border to relieve the siege.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong rebel Zhai Mingkai attacked Anyuan in Jiangxi from Nanxiong; Qiling sent troops across the border to lift the siege.

sentences.zh: 十一年，賊自安遠敗竄平遠，入福建，陷武平，耆齡分兵收復。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year bandits from Anyuan, defeated, fled through Pingyuan into Fujian and seized Wuping; Qiling divided his forces to recover it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year rebels fleeing defeat from Anyuan passed through Pingyuan into Fujian and took Wuping; Qiling sent detachments to recover it.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，命督軍入福建援浙江，擢閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was ordered to lead troops into Fujian to aid Zhejiang and was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he was ordered to lead troops into Fujian to aid Zhejiang and was made governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 粵匪陷處州，耆齡遣總兵秦如虎等分道進攻，直偪城下。

translations.literal: Guangdong rebels seized Chuzhou; Qiling dispatched Major General Qin Ruhu and others to attack on separate routes, pressing directly beneath the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong rebels took Chuzhou; Qiling sent Major General Qin Ruhu and others along separate routes until they were at the city walls.

sentences.zh: 賊竄縉雲，遂克處州，進收縉雲，再進复奉化。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to Jinyun; he then captured Chuzhou, advanced to recover Jinyun, and advanced again to recover Fenghua.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Jinyun; he then took Chuzhou, recovered Jinyun, and went on to retake Fenghua.

sentences.zh: 二年，復進克湯溪、永康、武義、龍遊、蘭谿諸縣，及金華府城，浙東略定。

translations.literal: In the second year he advanced again to capture Tangxi, Yongkang, Wuyi, Longyou, Lanxi, and other counties, as well as Jinhua prefectural city; eastern Zhejiang was largely settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he advanced to take Tangxi, Yongkang, Wuyi, Longyou, Lanxi, and other counties, along with Jinhua city, and eastern Zhejiang was largely pacified.

sentences.zh: 調福州將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to general of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the post of general of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，賜卹，諡恪慎。

translations.literal: He soon died; funeral gifts were bestowed and his posthumous title was Kejin.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died; the court granted funeral honors and gave him the posthumous title Kejin.

sentences.zh: 福濟，字元修，必祿氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Fu Ji, style name Yuanxiu, of the Bilu clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ji, whose courtesy name was Yuanxiu and who belonged to the Bilu clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 道光十三年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Daoguang he became a jinshi, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the thirteenth year of Daoguang, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was made a compiler.

sentences.zh: 擢侍講，四遷少詹事，大考二等，復三遷兵部侍郎，兼鑲白旗蒙古副都統、總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: He was promoted to lecturer, was transferred four times to junior guardian of the heir apparent, received second grade in the great examination, was again promoted three times to vice minister of the Ministry of War, and concurrently served as Mongol vice commander of the Bordered White Banner and superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to lecturer, was promoted four times to junior guardian of the heir apparent, scored second grade in the great examination, then rose three more times to vice minister of war, while also serving as Mongol vice commander of the Bordered White Banner and superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 調工部，復調吏部，兼右翼總兵。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Works, then again to the Ministry of Personnel, and concurrently served as commander of the Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to the Ministry of Works, then to the Ministry of Personnel, and also served as commander of the Right Wing.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，命偕右庶子駱秉章往河南、江蘇、山東按事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was ordered to accompany Right Sub-Reader Luo Bingzhang to Henan, Jiangsu, and Shandong to investigate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was ordered to accompany Right Sub-Reader Luo Bingzhang to investigate affairs in Henan, Jiangsu, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 歸德知府胡希週貪劣，鞫實，論如律。

translations.literal: Guide prefect Hu Xizhou was greedy and corrupt; the facts were established at trial and he was sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Guide Prefect Hu Xizhou was found greedy and corrupt; the facts were proved at trial and he was sentenced under the law.

sentences.zh: 河南賈魯河工糜費虛報，工竣河复淤，巡撫鄂順安以下皆坐譴。

translations.literal: The Jialu River works in Henan wasted funds with false reports; when the works were completed the river silted up again, and Governor E Shun'an and those below were all punished.
translations.idiomatic: The Jialu River project in Henan wasted money through false reporting; when the work was finished the river silted up again, and Governor E Shun'an and his subordinates were all punished.

sentences.zh: 蘇州知府鍾殿選等濫刑諱盜，鞫實，論如律。

translations.literal: Suzhou prefect Zhong Dianxuan and others abused punishments and concealed banditry; the facts were established and they were sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou Prefect Zhong Dianxuan and others had abused punishments and concealed banditry; the facts were proved and they were sentenced under the law.

sentences.zh: 又按山東鹽運使韋德成訐巡撫崇恩，勒令開缺，請交刑部逮治。

translations.literal: He also investigated Shandong salt transport commissioner Wei Decheng, who had impeached Governor Chong'en; Wei was compelled to vacate his post and was requested handed to the Ministry of Justice for arrest and trial.
translations.idiomatic: He also investigated Shandong Salt Transport Commissioner Wei Decheng for impeaching Governor Chong'en; Wei was forced to vacate his post and was referred to the Ministry of Justice for arrest.

sentences.zh: 復調戶部。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，授正白旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was appointed commander of the Plain White Banner guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he was appointed commander of the Plain White Banner guards.

sentences.zh: 命偕刑部侍郎陳孚恩按山西巡撫王兆琛贓污，兆琛坐譴。

translations.literal: He was ordered to accompany Vice Minister of Justice Chen Fu'en to investigate Shanxi Governor Wang Zhaochen for corruption; Wang was punished.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to join Vice Minister Chen Fu'en in investigating Shanxi Governor Wang Zhaochen for corruption; Wang was punished.

sentences.zh: 三十年，轉左翼總兵。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was transferred to commander of the Left Wing.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he became commander of the Left Wing.

sentences.zh: 醫士薛執中坐妖言得罪，事牽福濟，奪官。

translations.literal: The physician Xue Zhizhong was convicted on charges of heterodox speech; the affair implicated Fu Ji, who was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Physician Xue Zhizhong was convicted of spreading heterodox talk; the case implicated Fu Ji, who lost his office.

sentences.zh: 尋予四品頂戴，署山西按察使，授山東按察使。

translations.literal: He was soon given the fourth-rank insignia, acted as surveillance commissioner of Shanxi, and was appointed surveillance commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He soon received fourth-rank insignia, served as acting surveillance commissioner of Shanxi, and was appointed surveillance commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，授奉天府尹，擢南河河道總督。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng he was appointed prefect of Fengtian and promoted to director-general of the Southern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng he became prefect of Fengtian and was promoted to director-general of the Southern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 三年，調漕運總督，命暫行督辦淮北鹽務。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to director-general of grain transport and ordered temporarily to supervise Huaibei salt affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made director-general of grain transport and temporarily ordered to supervise Huaibei salt administration.

sentences.zh: 時粵匪踞江寧，擾江北，福濟會琦善敗賊揚州，授安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: At the time Guangdong rebels held Jiangning and harassed the north of the Yangtze; Fu Ji joined Qishan in defeating bandits at Yangzhou and was appointed governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong rebels then held Jiangning and raided north of the Yangtze; Fu Ji joined Qishan in defeating them at Yangzhou and was appointed governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 福濟調漕河標兵六百自臨淮關赴廬州，疏請飭琦善撥精兵二千扼關山、澗溪，防賊北竄；

translations.literal: Fu Ji transferred six hundred grain-transport banner troops from Linhuai Pass to Luzhou and memorialized requesting that Qishan allocate two thousand elite troops to hold Guanshan and Jianxi to prevent bandits fleeing north;
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ji moved six hundred grain-transport banner troops from Linhuai Pass to Luzhou and asked that Qishan send two thousand elite troops to hold Guanshan and Jianxi and block a northern rebel breakout;

sentences.zh: 又請仍兼督淮北鹽課，藉濟安徽軍餉：皆允之。

translations.literal: he also requested to continue concurrently supervising Huaibei salt revenue to help fund the Anhui army—all were granted.
translations.idiomatic: he also asked to keep supervising Huaibei salt revenue to fund the Anhui army—all were approved.

sentences.zh: 四年，至廬州，土匪陷六安，下部議處。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he reached Luzhou; local bandits seized Lu'an, and the matter was referred to the ministry for deliberation on punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he reached Luzhou; local bandits took Lu'an, and the case was sent to the ministry for disciplinary action.

sentences.zh: 福濟奏言：「抵廬後，統計調兵約二萬餘，月餉不下十五六萬。

translations.literal: Fu Ji memorialized, saying: "After reaching Luzhou, I tallied troops mobilized at about twenty thousand, with monthly pay no less than one hundred fifty to one hundred sixty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ji wrote: "After reaching Luzhou I found mobilized troops numbering about twenty thousand, with monthly pay of no less than 150,000 to 160,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 請飭浙、魯、秦、晉各撫臣協濟。」

translations.literal: I request orders to the governors of Zhejiang, Shandong, Shaanxi, and Shanxi to assist with funds."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the governors of Zhejiang, Shandong, Shaanxi, and Shanxi be ordered to contribute funds."

sentences.zh: 復請以前江南河道總督潘錫恩、安徽學政孫銘恩會辦徽州、寧國、廣德三府州防剿，俱從之。

translations.literal: He again requested that former Jiangnan Rivers Director-General Pan Xi'en and Anhui educational commissioner Sun Ming'en jointly manage defense and suppression in the three prefectures of Huizhou, Ningguo, and Guangde—all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that former Jiangnan Rivers Director Pan Xi'en and Anhui Educational Commissioner Sun Ming'en jointly handle defense in Huizhou, Ningguo, and Guangde—all were approved.

sentences.zh: 提督和春以欽差大臣督辦軍務，福濟與會師克六安，收英山、霍山。

translations.literal: Regional Commander He Chun served as imperial commissioner supervising military affairs; Fu Ji joined the united army in capturing Lu'an and recovering Yingshan and Huoshan.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander He Chun served as imperial commissioner over military affairs; Fu Ji joined the combined force to take Lu'an and recover Yingshan and Huoshan.

sentences.zh: 五年十月，克廬州，加太子少保、頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year Luzhou was captured; he was given the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and the first-rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year Luzhou was taken; he received the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and first-rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 於是廬江、巢縣、無為相繼克復，被優敘，賜御用棉袍、翎管、搬指、荷包。

translations.literal: Thereupon Lujiang, Chaoxian, and Wuwei were recovered in succession; he received special commendation and was granted an imperial cotton robe, feather tube, thumb ring, and pouch.
translations.idiomatic: Lujiang, Chaoxian, and Wuwei were then recovered in turn; he was specially commended and given an imperial cotton robe, feather tube, thumb ring, and pouch.

sentences.zh: 十一月，移軍桐城。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he moved his army to Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he shifted his forces to Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 七年，無為、廬州附近各縣復為賊陷，桐城被圍，屢擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Wuwei and counties near Luzhou again fell to bandits; Tongcheng was besieged and repeatedly drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Wuwei and nearby counties fell again; Tongcheng was besieged but repeatedly beat the attackers back.

sentences.zh: 二月，賊大至，福濟率兵潰圍出，還駐廬州。

translations.literal: In the second month bandits came in great force; Fu Ji led troops to break out of encirclement and returned to garrison Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month a large rebel force arrived; Fu Ji broke out of the encirclement and withdrew to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔斥調度無方，下部議處。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked his lack of effective command and referred the case to the ministry for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked his poor command and referred the case to the ministry for discipline.

sentences.zh: 未幾，六安复陷，福濟因病請開巡撫缺，專辦軍務，不許。

translations.literal: Before long Lu'an fell again; Fu Ji, citing illness, requested to vacate the governorship and devote himself solely to military affairs—this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Lu'an fell again; Fu Ji, citing illness, asked to give up the governorship and focus on military affairs alone—the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 時安徽本省無兵，軍務實主於和春。

translations.literal: At the time Anhui province itself had no troops; military affairs were in fact directed by He Chun.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui itself had no provincial troops at the time; military affairs were really run by He Chun.

sentences.zh: 賊踞安慶，皖南數郡懸隔，遙轄於浙江。

translations.literal: Bandits held Anqing; several southern Anhui prefectures were isolated and remotely administered from Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held Anqing; several southern Anhui districts were cut off and governed remotely from Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 淮北捻匪蔓延，袁甲三任之，巡撫號令所及，僅十餘縣。

translations.literal: Nian bandits spread across northern Huai; Yuan Jiasan was in charge of them, and the governor's orders reached only a dozen or so counties.
translations.idiomatic: Nian rebels spread across northern Huai under Yuan Jiasan, while the governor's authority reached only a dozen counties.

sentences.zh: 兵後荒蕪，賦稅無出，餉絀兵譁，遺失巡撫關防，自請嚴議，上原之，薄譴而已。

translations.literal: After warfare the land lay waste, taxes could not be collected, pay was short and troops mutinied, and the governor's seal was lost; he requested severe punishment himself; the emperor excused him with only a light reprimand.
translations.idiomatic: After the fighting the land lay waste, taxes could not be collected, pay ran short and troops mutinied, and he lost the governor's seal; he asked for severe punishment, but the emperor excused him with only a light rebuke.

sentences.zh: 會江南大營潰，和春移赴督師，惟總兵秦定三、鄭魁士兩軍仍留，倚以戰守。

translations.literal: When the Jiangnan great camp collapsed, He Chun moved to command the army in the field; only the armies of Major Generals Qin Dingsan and Zheng Kuishi remained, relied on for battle and defense.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jiangnan great camp collapsed, He Chun left to command in the field; only the forces of Major Generals Qin Dingsan and Zheng Kuishi remained for defense.

sentences.zh: 粵匪大股由湖北入皖，捻匪縱橫於皖、豫之交，省爭調定三、魁士二人。

translations.literal: Large Guangdong rebel forces entered Anhui from Hubei, and Nian bandits ranged across the Anhui-Henan border; the province competed to transfer Dingsan and Kuishi.
translations.idiomatic: Large Guangdong rebel columns entered Anhui from Hubei while Nian rebels ranged along the Anhui-Henan border; the province fought over transferring Dingsan and Kuishi.

sentences.zh: 奏上，皆報可，福濟依違無可否。

translations.literal: When memorials were submitted, all were approved; Fu Ji wavered without assent or refusal.
translations.idiomatic: The memorials were approved, but Fu Ji wavered without saying yes or no.

sentences.zh: 定三久攻桐城未下，魁士亦奉命而至，兩軍爭餉生嫌，賊乘隙撲營，遂致大潰。

translations.literal: Dingsan had long besieged Tongcheng without success; Kuishi also arrived by order; the two armies quarreled over pay and bore grudges; bandits seized the opening to storm the camps, leading to a great rout.
translations.idiomatic: Dingsan had long failed to take Tongcheng; Kuishi arrived as ordered; the two armies quarreled over pay; rebels seized the chance to storm the camps and caused a great rout.

sentences.zh: 八年，滁州、來安、鳳陽、懷遠相繼失陷。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Chuzhou, Lai'an, Fengyang, and Huaiyuan fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Chuzhou, Lai'an, Fengyang, and Huaiyuan fell one after another.

sentences.zh: 福濟以病乞假，詔斥日久無功，褫宮銜、頭品頂戴，命來京。

translations.literal: Fu Ji requested leave on grounds of illness; an edict rebuked his long lack of achievement, stripped his palace rank and first-rank insignia, and ordered him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ji asked for sick leave; an edict rebuked his long failure, stripped his palace rank and first-rank insignia, and ordered him to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 尋授內閣學士，予副都統銜，充西寧辦事大臣。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed a grand secretary, given vice commander rank, and made minister for Xining affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made a grand secretary, given vice commander rank, and appointed minister for Xining affairs.

sentences.zh: 九年，以安插投誠野番功，還頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, for settling surrendered wild tribes, his first-rank insignia was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year his first-rank insignia was restored for settling surrendered tribal groups.

sentences.zh: 十年，授工部侍郎，署陝甘總督，兼正黃旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Works, acted as governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu, and concurrently served as commander of the Hanjun of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he became vice minister of works, acted as governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu, and also commanded the Hanjun of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授成都將軍，調雲貴總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed general of Chengdu and transferred to governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was made general of Chengdu and transferred to governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 文宗崩，福濟奏請謁梓宮，不許，詔斥規避滇、黔軍務，褫職，予四品頂戴，仍赴雲南，交署總督潘鐸差遣。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wenzong died, Fu Ji memorialized requesting to attend the coffin; this was not permitted; an edict rebuked him for evading military affairs in Yunnan and Guizhou, stripped his office, gave him fourth-rank insignia, and still ordered him to Yunnan under Acting Governor Pan Duo.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenzong died, Fu Ji asked to attend the coffin; the request was denied; an edict accused him of evading Yunnan-Guizhou military duties, stripped his office, gave him fourth-rank insignia, and still sent him to Yunnan under Acting Governor Pan Duo.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，予副都統銜赴西藏查辦事件，道梗未往。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was given vice commander rank to go to Tibet to investigate affairs; the route was blocked and he did not go.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he was given vice commander rank to investigate affairs in Tibet, but the route was blocked and he never went.

sentences.zh: 四年，還京。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he went back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 六年，授科布多幫辦大臣，調布倫託海辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed assistant minister at Kobdo and transferred to minister at Buluntuohai.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he became assistant minister at Kobdo and was transferred to minister at Buluntuohai.

sentences.zh: 八年，授烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed general at Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was made general at Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 九年，回匪陷烏里雅蘇台，褫職。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Hui rebels seized Uliastai and he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Hui rebels took Uliastai and he was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 十二年，捐銀助賑。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he donated silver to aid famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he donated silver for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 直隸總督李鴻章為陳在安徽前勞，還原銜。

translations.literal: Zhili Governor-General Li Hongzhang memorialized on his earlier labors in Anhui, and his original rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili Governor-General Li Hongzhang cited his earlier service in Anhui, and his original rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，卒，依巡撫例賜卹。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he died; funeral gifts were bestowed according to the governor precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu he died and received funeral honors according to the governor precedent.

sentences.zh: 翁同書，字藥房，江蘇常熟人，大學士心存子。

translations.literal: Weng Tongshu, style name Yaofang, was a native of Changshu in Jiangsu, son of Grand Secretary Xincun.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Tongshu, whose courtesy name was Yaofang, came from Changshu in Jiangsu and was the son of Grand Secretary Xincun.

sentences.zh: 道光二十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Daoguang he became a jinshi, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the twentieth year of Daoguang, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was made a compiler.

sentences.zh: 大考屢列二等，擢中允。

translations.literal: In the great examinations he repeatedly ranked second grade and was promoted to palace aide.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly scored second grade in the great examinations and was promoted to palace aide.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，應詔陳四事：請撫卹失業良民；

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, in response to an edict he presented four items: request relief for unemployed common people;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng, answering an imperial edict, he presented four proposals: relief for unemployed common people;

sentences.zh: 察舉潔己愛民守令；

translations.literal: investigate and recommend incorrupt officials who love the people;
translations.idiomatic: investigation and recommendation of incorrupt, people-loving local officials;

sentences.zh: ​​興修江、浙、湖廣水利；

translations.literal: repair waterworks in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Huguang;
translations.idiomatic: repair of waterworks in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Huguang;

sentences.zh: 訓練嶺海水師。

translations.literal: train the coastal naval forces of the Lingnan region.
translations.idiomatic: training of the Lingnan coastal navy.

sentences.zh: 三年，命赴江南佐欽差大臣琦善軍事。

translations.literal: In the third year he was ordered to Jiangnan to assist Imperial Commissioner Qishan in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was sent to Jiangnan to assist Imperial Commissioner Qishan in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 擢侍講學士，轉侍讀學士，遷少詹事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to expositor of the Hanlin Academy, transferred to reader of the Hanlin Academy, and moved to junior guardian of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to expositor of the Hanlin Academy, became a reader there, and was appointed junior guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 六年，自軍中奏言：「安民先足兵，足兵先理財。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, from the army he memorialized, saying: "To pacify the people one must first have sufficient troops; to have sufficient troops one must first manage finances.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he wrote from camp: "To pacify the people you must first have enough troops; to have enough troops you must first manage finances.

sentences.zh: 雲南運銅道梗，請於滇中設局鼓鑄，運錢至荊州充軍需及河工之用。

translations.literal: The Yunnan copper transport route was blocked; he requested establishing minting bureaus in Yunnan and transporting coin to Jingzhou for army needs and river works.
translations.idiomatic: With the Yunnan copper route blocked, he asked to set up mints in Yunnan and ship coin to Jingzhou for army supplies and river works.

sentences.zh: 沿江戒嚴，淮南鹽引不行，請以浙鹽行江西，而以蘇、常、鎮、太四府州改食淮鹽。

translations.literal: Along the river defenses were on alert and Huainan salt certificates did not circulate; he requested Zhejiang salt for Jiangxi and that the four prefectures of Su, Chang, Zhen, and Tai switch to Huai salt.
translations.idiomatic: With river defenses on alert and Huainan salt certificates stalled, he proposed sending Zhejiang salt to Jiangxi and switching Suzhou, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, and Taicang to Huai salt.

sentences.zh: 江、浙漕米改由海運，數不及全漕之半，請分米僱民船仍由運河行轉搬之法。

translations.literal: Jiangsu and Zhejiang grain tribute was changed to sea transport, amounting to less than half the full canal transport; he requested dividing grain and hiring civilian boats to continue the canal relay method.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu and Zhejiang tribute grain now went by sea, less than half the old canal volume; he asked to split shipments and hire civilian boats to continue canal relay transport.

sentences.zh: 馬政廢弛，請令營馬量減數成，牧馬除借營用，令變價解庫。

translations.literal: Horse administration had fallen into neglect; he requested reducing camp horses by several tenths, and besides lending camp horses, selling pasture horses for treasury deposit.
translations.idiomatic: Horse administration had decayed; he asked to cut camp horses by several tenths and sell surplus pasture horses into the treasury.

sentences.zh: 各省營兵應調赴戰，請飭將傷病撤回。

translations.literal: Garrison troops of all provinces should be mobilized for battle; he requested ordering withdrawal of the wounded and sick.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial garrison troops should fight where needed; he asked that the wounded and sick be sent home.

sentences.zh: 空糧缺伍，實力整頓。

translations.literal: Phantom rations and missing soldiers should be vigorously rectified.
translations.idiomatic: Phantom rations and empty ranks should be cleaned up in earnest.

sentences.zh: 軍興各省州縣倉穀或遭蹂躪，或備供億，實存綦少，請令地方官勸富民納粟入倉，量​​予獎勵。」

translations.literal: With warfare rising, granary grain in provinces and counties was either ravaged or expended for supplies, with very little actually stored; he requested local officials encourage wealthy households to contribute grain to granaries with proportional rewards."
translations.idiomatic: In wartime, county granaries were either looted or drained for supplies, leaving almost nothing; he asked local officials to urge wealthy households to donate grain to granaries with suitable rewards."

sentences.zh: 又疏陳江防五事，曰：扼要津，聯陸路，斷岸姦，議火攻，增小船，並下部議行。

translations.literal: He also memorialized five items for river defense: hold key crossings, link land routes, cut off shore traitors, discuss fire attack, and increase small boats—all referred to the ministry for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed five river-defense measures—hold key crossings, link land routes, cut shore traitors, use fire attack, and add small boats—and all were sent to the ministry.

sentences.zh: 琦善卒，托明阿為欽差大臣，同書仍留佐軍事。

translations.literal: When Qishan died, Tuoming'a became imperial commissioner; Tongshu remained to assist military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After Qishan died, Tuoming'a became imperial commissioner, and Tongshu stayed on to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 粵匪再陷揚州，托明阿坐罷，德興阿代之，詔同書幫辦軍務。

translations.literal: Guangdong rebels again seized Yangzhou; Tuoming'a was dismissed for responsibility; Dexing'a replaced him; Tongshu was ordered to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong rebels took Yangzhou again; Tuoming'a was dismissed; Dexing'a replaced him; Tongshu was ordered to help manage military affairs.

sentences.zh: 德興阿連复揚州、浦口，進規瓜洲、鎮江，軍事日有起色，多出同書贊畫。

translations.literal: Dexing'a recovered Yangzhou and Pukou in succession, advanced planning for Guazhou and Zhenjiang, and military affairs daily improved—largely through Tongshu's planning.
translations.idiomatic: Dexing'a retook Yangzhou and Pukou, pressed toward Guazhou and Zhenjiang, and the campaign steadily improved—largely thanks to Tongshu's planning.

sentences.zh: 克瓜洲，命以侍郎候補，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: When Guazhou was captured, he was ordered to await appointment as vice minister and was granted the yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: After Guazhou fell, he was ordered to await appointment as vice minister and given the yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，授安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year he was appointed governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year he became governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 時廬州再陷，粵匪、捻匪相勾結，淮南北蹂躪殆遍。

translations.literal: At the time Luzhou had fallen again; Guangdong and Nian rebels were mutually linked, and north and south of the Huai were nearly all ravaged.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou had fallen again; Guangdong and Nian rebels were in league, and both sides of the Huai were nearly ruined.

sentences.zh: 上命同書幫辦欽差大臣勝保軍務，安徽境各軍均歸節制。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Tongshu to assist Imperial Commissioner Sheng Bao in military affairs; all armies within Anhui were placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Tongshu to assist Imperial Commissioner Sheng Bao; all Anhui forces were placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 同書移軍定遠，賊自天長犯三河集，擊破之，复天長。

translations.literal: Tongshu moved his army to Dingyuan; bandits from Tianchang attacked Sanheji; he defeated them and recovered Tianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Tongshu moved to Dingyuan; rebels from Tianchang attacked Sanheji; he defeated them and retook Tianchang.

sentences.zh: 捻匪擾定遠，粵匪亦來犯，同書督兵擊卻之。

translations.literal: Nian bandits harassed Dingyuan and Guangdong rebels also attacked; Tongshu directed troops and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Nian rebels harassed Dingyuan and Guangdong rebels attacked as well; Tongshu led troops and beat them back.

sentences.zh: 九年，捻匪大​​舉陷六安，攻定遠，同書與勝保夾擊，大破之，复六安。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Nian rebels in great force seized Lu'an and attacked Dingyuan; Tongshu and Sheng Bao attacked from both sides, inflicted a great defeat, and recovered Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year a large Nian force took Lu'an and attacked Dingyuan; Tongshu and Sheng Bao struck from both sides, routed them, and retook Lu'an.

sentences.zh: 捻匪復合粵匪數万人來犯，定遠陷，同書移軍壽州，下​​吏議，革職留任。

translations.literal: Nian rebels again joined tens of thousands of Guangdong rebels in attack; Dingyuan fell; Tongshu moved his army to Shouzhou; the case was referred to judicial authorities; he was stripped of office but retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: Nian rebels joined tens of thousands of Guangdong rebels; Dingyuan fell; Tongshu withdrew to Shouzhou; the case went to the judiciary; he was stripped of rank but kept in office.

sentences.zh: 同書奏：「近來可用之兵，莫如楚師。

translations.literal: Tongshu memorialized: "Among troops usable recently, none compare to the Hunan army.
translations.idiomatic: Tongshu wrote: "Of the forces available today, none match the Hunan army.

sentences.zh: 諜聞楚師順江而下，已破石牌。

translations.literal: Spies report the Hunan army is moving down the river and has already taken Shipai.
translations.idiomatic: Intelligence says the Hunan army is coming downriver and has already taken Shipai.

sentences.zh: 倘別遣勁旅間道急趨英、霍，徐圖懷、定，此上策也。

translations.literal: If another elite force is sent by a hidden route to hurry to Ying and Huo and gradually plan for Huaiyuan and Dingyuan, this is the best strategy.
translations.idiomatic: If we send another strong column by a side route to rush to Ying and Huo and then work toward Huaiyuan and Dingyuan, that is the best plan.

sentences.zh: 如楚師轉戰未能深入，用苗沛霖輔以官軍，先拔懷遠，此中策也。

translations.literal: If the Hunan army, turning to battle, cannot penetrate deeply, use Miao Peilin assisted by government troops to first take Huaiyuan—this is the middle strategy.
translations.idiomatic: If the Hunan army cannot push deep in its campaign, use Miao Peilin with government troops to take Huaiyuan first—that is the middle plan.

sentences.zh: 若二者皆不能行，則以勝保攻明光，李世忠逾清流關以保東路，臣守壽州，與傅振邦、關保相應援，制孫葵心、劉添福二巨捻以保西路，此下策也。」

translations.literal: If neither can be done, then have Sheng Bao attack Mingguang, Li Shizhong cross Qingliu Pass to secure the eastern route, I guard Shouzhou and coordinate with Fu Zhenbang and Guan Bao, and contain the two great Nian leaders Sun Kuixin and Liu Tianfu to secure the western route—this is the worst strategy."
translations.idiomatic: If neither works, let Sheng Bao attack Mingguang, Li Shizhong cross Qingliu Pass to hold the east, I hold Shouzhou with Fu Zhenbang and Guan Bao in support, and contain the great Nian leaders Sun Kuixin and Liu Tianfu in the west—that is the worst plan."

sentences.zh: 葵心攻潁州，同書遣兵擊之，敗走，复霍山。

translations.literal: Kuixin attacked Yingzhou; Tongshu dispatched troops, defeated him, and he fled; Huoshan was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: When Kuixin attacked Yingzhou, Tongshu sent troops, routed him, and recovered Huoshan.

sentences.zh: 十年，遣兵攻爐橋，焚賊壘，進擊舒城援賊，破王家海賊圩。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he dispatched troops to attack Luqiao, burned rebel stockades, advanced against Shucheng relief rebels, and broke the rebel fort at Wangjiahai.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he sent troops to attack Luqiao, burned rebel camps, struck Shucheng relief forces, and destroyed the rebel fort at Wangjiahai.

sentences.zh: 勝保議招葵心，上諮同書，同書言師方攻程家圩賊巢，不必曲意招撫。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao proposed recruiting Kuixin; the emperor consulted Tongshu; Tongshu said the army was just attacking the rebel nest at Chengjiayu and need not bend to appeasement.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao wanted to recruit Kuixin; the emperor asked Tongshu, who said the army was attacking the rebel nest at Chengjiayu and there was no need to appease him.

sentences.zh: 俄拔程家圩。

translations.literal: Soon Chengjiayu was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Chengjiayu fell.

sentences.zh: 英法聯軍犯京師，勝保請召苗沛霖練勇入援，命同書傳旨；

translations.literal: The Anglo-French allied armies attacked the capital; Sheng Bao requested summoning Miao Peilin's trained braves to reinforce; Tongshu was ordered to transmit the edict;
translations.idiomatic: When the Anglo-French allies attacked the capital, Sheng Bao asked to summon Miao Peilin's militia; Tongshu was ordered to convey the edict;

sentences.zh: 同書亦自請開巡撫缺，率之同行：尋並諭止之。

translations.literal: Tongshu also requested himself to vacate the governorship and lead them together—soon both were ordered stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Tongshu also asked to give up the governorship and lead them north—soon both requests were denied.

sentences.zh: 粵匪陳玉成攻壽州，同書力禦，尋退。

translations.literal: Guangdong rebel Chen Yucheng attacked Shouzhou; Tongshu resisted strenuously and the rebels soon withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yucheng attacked Shouzhou; Tongshu held firm and the rebels soon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 苗沛霖本懷反側，見時方多故，益猖恣，因與壽州團練徐立壯、孫家泰等有嫌，會其所部數人為立壯所殺，遂圍攻壽州。

translations.literal: Miao Peilin had long been disloyal at heart; seeing troubled times, he grew more arrogant; he had grudges with Shouzhou militia leaders Xu Lizhuang and Sun Jiatai; when several of his men were killed by Lizhuang, he besieged Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Peilin had always been unreliable; troubled times made him bolder; he feuded with Shouzhou militia leaders Xu Lizhuang and Sun Jiatai; after Lizhuang killed several of his men, he besieged Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 同書密疏陳沛霖跋扈，詔飭會袁甲三查辦。

translations.literal: Tongshu secretly memorialized that Peilin was overbearing; an edict ordered joint investigation with Yuan Jiasan.
translations.idiomatic: Tongshu secretly reported Peilin's arrogance; an edict ordered Yuan Jiasan to investigate jointly.

sentences.zh: 沛霖抗不聽命，圍攻益急，縱兵四擾。

translations.literal: Peilin resisted orders, pressed the siege harder, and let his troops rampage on all sides.
translations.idiomatic: Peilin defied orders, tightened the siege, and let his troops raid everywhere.

sentences.zh: 立壯所部多舊捻，素騷擾為民怨，十一年，坐其通捻，殺之。

translations.literal: Lizhuang's followers were mostly old Nian bandits who had long harassed the people and aroused resentment; in the eleventh year, on grounds of collusion with Nian bandits, he was killed.
