translations.idiomatic: Lizhuang's men were mostly old Nian rebels who had long harassed the people; in the eleventh year he was executed for colluding with the Nian.

sentences.zh: 又下孫家泰於獄，家泰自殺。

translations.literal: Sun Jiatai was also imprisoned; Jiatai committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jiatai was also jailed and committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 以蒙時中付沛霖，沛霖仍不息兵。

translations.literal: Meng Shizhong was handed over to Peilin, but Peilin still did not cease hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Shizhong was handed to Peilin, but Peilin still would not stop fighting.

sentences.zh: 召同書還京，以賈臻代署巡撫。

translations.literal: Tongshu was recalled to the capital; Jia Zhen acted as governor in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Tongshu was recalled to Beijing; Jia Zhen served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 同書令署布政使張學鵬勸諭沛霖，始撤圍。

translations.literal: Tongshu ordered Acting Provincial Treasurer Zhang Xuepeng to persuade Peilin, and he finally lifted the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Tongshu had Acting Provincial Treasurer Zhang Xuepeng persuade Peilin, and the siege was finally lifted.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「沛霖過猶知改，請量加撫慰，責剿捻贖罪，俾袁甲三、賈臻籌辦善後事宜。」

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "Peilin, though at fault, still knows how to reform; please add appropriate consolation, charge him to suppress the Nian to redeem his guilt, and let Yuan Jiasan and Jia Zhen arrange aftermath affairs."
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: "Peilin still shows he can reform; please console him appropriately, charge him to fight the Nian to atone, and let Yuan Jiasan and Jia Zhen handle the aftermath."

sentences.zh: 同治元年，曾國籓奏劾同書於定遠失守時棄城走壽州，復不能妥辦，致紳練有仇殺之事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi Zeng Guofan memorialized impeaching Tongshu for abandoning the city and fleeing to Shouzhou when Dingyuan fell, then failing to handle matters properly, leading to mutual killings among gentry militia.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi Zeng Guofan impeached Tongshu for fleeing Dingyuan to Shouzhou when the city fell, then mishandling affairs so that gentry militia turned on one another.

sentences.zh: 迨壽州城陷，奏報情形前後矛盾，命褫職逮問。

translations.literal: When Shouzhou city fell, his reports were contradictory before and after; he was ordered stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: When Shouzhou fell, his reports contradicted one another; he was stripped of office and arrested.

sentences.zh: 王大臣會鞫，擬大辟。

translations.literal: Princes and ministers jointly tried him and proposed the death penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and ministers tried him jointly and recommended execution.

sentences.zh: 父心存病篤，暫釋侍湯藥。

translations.literal: His father Xincun was gravely ill; he was temporarily released to attend him with medicine.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xincun was dying; he was temporarily released to nurse him.

sentences.zh: 心存卒，復命持服百日仍入獄。

translations.literal: When Xincun died, he was again ordered to observe mourning for a hundred days and then return to prison.
translations.idiomatic: After Xincun died, he was ordered to mourn a hundred days and then return to prison.

sentences.zh: 二年，改戍新疆。

translations.literal: In the second year his sentence was changed to exile in Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was sentenced to exile in Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 三年，都興阿請留甘肅軍營效力，以花馬池戰捷，獲賊渠孫義保，賜四品頂戴。

translations.literal: In the third year Duxing'a requested he remain to serve in the Gansu army; for victory at Huamachi he captured rebel chief Sun Yibao and was granted fourth-rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Duxing'a asked him to serve in the Gansu army; after victory at Huamachi he captured rebel chief Sun Yibao and received fourth-rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，復原官，贈右都御史，諡文勤。

translations.literal: He soon died; his original office was restored; he was posthumously given Right Censor-in-Chief and the title Wenqin.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died; his rank was restored posthumously; he was given Right Censor-in-Chief and the posthumous title Wenqin.

sentences.zh: 嚴樹森，初名澍森，字渭春，四川新繁人，原籍陝西渭南。

translations.literal: Yan Shusen, original name Shusen, style name Weichun, was a native of Xinfan in Sichuan with original household registration in Weinan, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shusen, originally named Shusen and courtesy name Weichun, came from Xinfan in Sichuan though his ancestral home was Weinan in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 道光二十年舉人，入貲為內閣中書。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Daoguang he became a provincial graduate and purchased appointment as a secretary in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination in the twentieth year of Daoguang and bought appointment as a Grand Secretariat secretary.

sentences.zh: 改知縣，銓授湖北東湖，捐升同知。

translations.literal: He changed to magistrate, was selected for Donghu in Hubei, and purchased promotion to subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: He became a magistrate, was assigned to Donghu in Hubei, and purchased promotion to subprefect.

sentences.zh: 以防剿功，晉秩知府，署武昌府。

translations.literal: For achievements in defense and suppression he was promoted to prefect and acted as prefect of Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: For defense and suppression work he was promoted to prefect and served as acting prefect of Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 巡撫胡林翼薦之，八年，擢荊宜施道，遷按察使。

translations.literal: Governor Hu Linyi recommended him; in the eighth year he was promoted to intendant of Jing-Yi-Shi and moved to surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Hu Linyi recommended him; in the eighth year he became intendant of Jing-Yi-Shi and then surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷布政使，擢河南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was moved to provincial treasurer and promoted to governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he became provincial treasurer and was promoted to governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 時皖捻縱橫於河南境內，又有汝寧土匪陳大喜、金樓教匪郜永清皆猖獗。

translations.literal: At the time Anhui Nian bandits ranged within Henan, and local bandit Chen Daxi of Runing and Jinlou sect rebel Gao Yongqing were all rampant.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui Nian rebels ranged across Henan, while Runing bandit Chen Daxi and Jinlou sect rebel Gao Yongqing were also rampant.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月，捻匪姜台凌自歸德犯省城，援軍集，遂南趨陷唐縣，攻南陽府城，圍鄧州、裕州，三月，始回巢。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year Nian rebel Jiang Tailing from Guide attacked the provincial capital; when reinforcements gathered he turned south, seized Tang county, attacked Nanyang prefectural city, besieged Dengzhou and Yuzhou, and only in the third month returned to his base.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eleventh year Nian leader Jiang Tailing attacked the capital from Guide; when reinforcements arrived he turned south, took Tang county, attacked Nanyang, besieged Dengzhou and Yuzhou, and did not return to his base until the third month.

sentences.zh: 孫葵心犯光州、陳州，亦至三月始出境。

translations.literal: Sun Kuixin invaded Guangzhou and Chenzhou and also did not leave until the third month.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Kuixin raided Guangzhou and Chenzhou and likewise did not withdraw until the third month.

sentences.zh: 苗沛霖黨勾結陳大喜等擾陳州、汝寧邊境。

translations.literal: Miao Peilin's faction linked with Chen Daxi and others to harass the borders of Chenzhou and Runing.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Peilin's faction joined Chen Daxi and others in harassing the Chenzhou and Runing border.

sentences.zh: 五月，雷彥等圍鹿邑，經月始回巢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Lei Yan and others besieged Luyi and only after a month returned to base.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Lei Yan besieged Luyi and withdrew only after a month.

sentences.zh: 七月，劉狗大股分黑、白、花三旗擾歸德，結金樓教匪攻馬牧寨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Liu Gou's large force divided into black, white, and flower banners and harassed Guide, joining Jinlou sect rebels to attack Mamu stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Liu Gou's main force split into black, white, and flower banners, raided Guide, and joined Jinlou rebels to attack Mamu stockade.

sentences.zh: 樹森出駐陳州督剿。

translations.literal: Shusen went out to garrison Chenzhou and supervise suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Shusen moved to Chenzhou to direct suppression.

sentences.zh: 八月，劉狗竄硃仙鎮，犯省城。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Liu Gou fled to Zhuxian town and attacked the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Liu Gou reached Zhuxian and attacked the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 樹森率兵回援，賊竄汜水、鞏縣，掠黑石關，回竄鄭州，仍由歸德回巢。

translations.literal: Shusen led troops back to reinforce; bandits fled through Qishui and Gong county, plundered Heishi Pass, returned through Zhengzhou, and still went back to base by Guide.
translations.idiomatic: Shusen rushed back with troops; the rebels fled through Qishui and Gong, raided Heishi Pass, doubled back through Zhengzhou, and returned to base by Guide.

sentences.zh: 姜台凌亦犯沈丘、裕州，越樊城，復入荊子關，擾南、汝兩郡，由柘城、鹿邑回巢。

translations.literal: Jiang Tailing also invaded Shenqiu and Yuzhou, crossed Fancheng, re-entered Jingzi Pass, harassed the Nan and Ru prefectures, and returned to base through Zhecheng and Luyi.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Tailing also struck Shenqiu and Yuzhou, crossed Fancheng, re-entered Jingzi Pass, raided the Nan and Ru districts, and withdrew through Zhecheng and Luyi.

sentences.zh: 十月，劉狗復大舉援金樓寨，為官軍所阻，未得逞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Liu Gou again came in force to aid Jinlou stockade but was blocked by government troops and did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Liu Gou again marched to relieve Jinlou stockade but government troops blocked him.

sentences.zh: 時苗沛霖复叛，結張洛行，與汝寧、正陽、息縣諸匪連絡，將犯河南。

translations.literal: At the time Miao Peilin rebelled again, joined Zhang Luoxing, linked with rebels of Runing, Zhengyang, and Xi counties, and was about to invade Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Peilin rebelled again, joined Zhang Luoxing, linked with rebels across Runing, Zhengyang, and Xi, and prepared to invade Henan.

sentences.zh: 樹森偕團練大臣毛昶熙合疏請調宜昌鎮總兵李續燾及鮑超部將陳由立，各募楚勇三千赴豫，又調吉林馬隊一千，以資防剿，請增兵之後，山西、陝西月協銀各二萬兩，允之。

translations.literal: Shusen together with militia commissioner Mao Changxi jointly memorialized requesting transfer of Yichang garrison commander Li Xuyi and Bao Chao's officer Chen Youli, each to recruit three thousand Hunan braves for Henan, and also transfer one thousand Jilin cavalry for defense and suppression; after requesting more troops, monthly aid of twenty thousand taels each from Shanxi and Shaanxi was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Shusen and Militia Commissioner Mao Changxi jointly asked to bring in Yichang commander Li Xuyi and Bao Chao's officer Chen Youli, each to raise three thousand Hunan braves for Henan, plus one thousand Jilin cavalry; afterward monthly subsidies of twenty thousand taels each from Shanxi and Shaanxi were approved.

sentences.zh: 樹森老於吏事，在湖北從胡林翼治兵久，堅愎自是，與毛昶熙不合，事相掣肘。

translations.literal: Shusen was experienced in administration; in Hubei he had long followed Hu Linyi in managing troops; stubborn and self-assured, he did not get along with Mao Changxi and their affairs mutually obstructed each other.
translations.idiomatic: Shusen was a seasoned administrator who had long served under Hu Linyi in Hubei; stubborn and self-willed, he clashed with Mao Changxi and they obstructed each other.

sentences.zh: 治河南年餘，禦賊雖有擒斬，軍事不得要領，迄無起色，調湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Governing Henan for more than a year, though there were captures and kills in resisting bandits, military affairs never grasped essentials and showed no improvement; he was transferred to governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year in Henan he had some victories but never mastered the campaign; he was transferred to governor of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，粵匪陳得才自南陽趨陝邊，捻匪竄永寧，延及雒南。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi Guangdong rebel Chen Decai from Nanyang moved toward the Shaanxi border; Nian rebels slipped into Yongning and spread to Luonan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi Chen Decai moved from Nanyang toward Shaanxi; Nian rebels entered Yongning and spread to Luonan.

sentences.zh: 樹森疏言：「當今賊勢，不患其並力南趨，特慮其潛窺陝境。

translations.literal: Shusen memorialized, saying: "Today's rebel strength—one need not fear their combining to drive south, but especially fear their secretly watching the Shaanxi border.
translations.idiomatic: Shusen wrote: "Today's rebels are not the main worry if they push south together; the real fear is a stealthy move into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 西、同、鳳三府為全陝菁華所萃，宜急驅出關，會合夾擊，以保完善之區。」

translations.literal: The three prefectures of Xi, Tong, and Feng gather the finest of all Shaanxi; they should be urgently driven out of the passes, attacked from both sides in concert, to preserve this intact region."
translations.idiomatic: Xi, Tong, and Feng hold Shaanxi's heartland; we should drive the rebels out of the passes at once and crush them from both sides to preserve that intact region."

sentences.zh: 五月，賊犯鄖西，令總兵何紹彩敗之何家店。

translations.literal: In the fifth month rebels invaded Yunxi; he ordered Major General He Shaocai to defeat them at Hejiadian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month rebels raided Yunxi; he sent Major General He Shaocai to defeat them at Hejiadian.

sentences.zh: 會道員金國琛赴鄖策應，令周鳳山分兵剿正陽、羅山，破賊巢，克邢家集、龍井、陡溝、明港。

translations.literal: When circuit intendant Jin Guochen went to Yun for coordination, he ordered Zhou Fengshan to divide troops to suppress Zhengyang and Luoshan, destroy rebel nests, and capture Xingjiaji, Longjing, Dougou, and Minggang.
translations.idiomatic: When Circuit Intendant Jin Guochen went to Yun to coordinate, he sent Zhou Fengshan to clear Zhengyang and Luoshan, destroy rebel nests, and take Xingjiaji, Longjing, Dougou, and Minggang.

sentences.zh: 敘、捻諸匪合陷隨州，陳大喜陷京山，馬融和陷德安，令舒保擊敗德安賊，穆正春复京山、應城，襄北稍定。

translations.literal: Rebels of Xuzhou and Nian jointly seized Suizhou; Chen Daxi seized Jingshan; Ma Ronghe seized De'an; he ordered Shu Bao to defeat De'an rebels; Mu Zhengchun recovered Jingshan and Yingcheng; northern Xiangyang was somewhat settled.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou and Nian rebels together took Suizhou; Chen Daxi took Jingshan; Ma Ronghe took De'an; Shu Bao defeated the De'an rebels; Mu Zhengchun retook Jingshan and Yingcheng; northern Xiangyang calmed somewhat.

sentences.zh: 因星變，奏劾欽差大臣勝保。

translations.literal: Because of a celestial anomaly, he memorialized impeaching Imperial Commissioner Sheng Bao.
translations.idiomatic: Citing a celestial anomaly, he impeached Imperial Commissioner Sheng Bao.

sentences.zh: 又奏言：「籓、臬任重，不得以軍功擅請記名。

translations.literal: He again memorialized, saying: "Provincial treasurers and surveillance commissioners bear heavy responsibility and must not on their own request registration for military merit.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: "Provincial treasurers and surveillance commissioners hold heavy responsibility and must not seek military merit registration on their own.

sentences.zh: 標兵缺額，請以戰勇充補。

translations.literal: Garrison soldier vacancies should be filled with battle braves.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison vacancies should be filled with combat troops.

sentences.zh: 陣亡卹賞欠發，許作子孫捐項，敘給官階職銜貢監。

translations.literal: Unpaid death benefits should be allowed as donation items for descendants, with ranks, titles, and imperial student status granted.
translations.idiomatic: Unpaid death benefits should be convertible into donation credit for descendants, with official ranks and titles granted.

sentences.zh: 京官五品以下，官俸實發不折。」

translations.literal: Capital officials of fifth rank and below should receive full salaries without discount."
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials of fifth rank and below should receive full pay without discount."

sentences.zh: 下部分別議行。

translations.literal: The items were referred to the ministries for separate deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries were asked to deliberate and implement each item separately.

sentences.zh: 二年，捻匪竄城，樹森赴黃州視師，督舒保、穆正春等擊走之。

translations.literal: In the second year Nian rebels raided the city; Shusen went to Huangzhou to inspect the army and directed Shu Bao, Mu Zhengchun, and others to drive them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Nian rebels raided the city; Shusen went to Huangzhou to take command and drove them off with Shu Bao and Mu Zhengchun.

sentences.zh: 三年，粵、捻諸匪由陝南合趨湖北，詔總督官文出省督師，樹森留防省城。

translations.literal: In the third year Guangdong and Nian rebels from southern Shaanxi converged on Hubei; Governor Guan Wen was ordered out to command troops; Shusen remained to defend the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Guangdong and Nian rebels from southern Shaanxi converged on Hubei; Governor Guan Wen was ordered out to command; Shusen stayed to defend the capital.

sentences.zh: 官文奏劾樹森把持兵柄，舊營悉改隸撫標。

translations.literal: Guan Wen memorialized impeaching Shusen for monopolizing military power and transferring all old camps to the governor's banner.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen impeached Shusen for monopolizing military power and placing all old camps under the governor's banner.

sentences.zh: 上斥其任意妄為，降道員。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked his arbitrary conduct and demoted him to circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: The throne rebuked his arbitrary ways and reduced him to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 四年，授廣西按察使，貴州巡撫張亮基被劾玩兵侵餉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed surveillance commissioner of Guangxi; Guizhou Governor Zhang Liangji was impeached for neglecting troops and embezzling pay.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he became surveillance commissioner of Guangxi while Guizhou Governor Zhang Liangji was impeached for neglecting troops and embezzling pay.

sentences.zh: 縱暴殃民諸款，命樹森馳往查奏。

translations.literal: On charges of indulging violence and harming the people, Shusen was ordered to hurry there to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: On charges of indulging violence and harming the people, Shusen was ordered to rush there and investigate.

sentences.zh: 五年，授貴州布政使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed provincial treasurer of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he became provincial treasurer of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 樹森逗遛不進，未至，即奏覆參案。

translations.literal: Shusen delayed and did not advance; before arriving he already memorialized closing the impeachment case.
translations.idiomatic: Shusen delayed and never arrived; he reported on the impeachment case before he got there.

sentences.zh: 六年，疏請開缺，詔斥其規避取巧，褫職，發往雲南差遣委用。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he memorialized requesting to vacate his post; an edict rebuked his evasive trickery, stripped his office, and sent him to Yunnan for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he asked to resign; an edict accused him of evasive trickery, stripped his office, and sent him to Yunnan for assignment.

sentences.zh: 十一年，予四品頂戴，署廣西按察使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was given fourth-rank insignia and acted as surveillance commissioner of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he received fourth-rank insignia and served as acting surveillance commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，遷布政使，就擢巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he was moved to provincial treasurer and then promoted to governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu he became provincial treasurer and was then promoted to governor.

sentences.zh: 二年，卒，賜卹。

translations.literal: In the second year he died; funeral gifts were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he died and received funeral honors.

sentences.zh: 論曰：王懿德治閩，悍寇未深入。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Wang Yide governed Fujian; fierce bandits did not penetrate deeply.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Wang Yide governed Fujian before the fiercest rebels could penetrate deep inland.

sentences.zh: 鎮輯萑苻，尚能保境。

translations.literal: He pacified local brambles and reeds and could still preserve the territory.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified local unrest and still held the province together.

sentences.zh: 曾望顏在言路有聲，治兵無術，蜀亂遂成。

translations.literal: Ceng Wangyan had a reputation on the remonstrance path but lacked military skill, and the Sichuan turmoil thus formed.
translations.idiomatic: Ceng Wangyan was respected as a censor but knew no military art, and the Sichuan rebellion took shape under him.

sentences.zh: 耆齡輯睦湘軍，因人成事。

translations.literal: Qiling harmonized the Hunan army and accomplished things through others' efforts.
translations.idiomatic: Qiling worked well with the Hunan army and succeeded mainly by relying on others.

sentences.zh: 安徽兵餉俱絀，四郊多壘，福濟固一籌莫展。

translations.literal: Anhui's military pay was all short, enemy camps stood on all four sides, and Fu Ji truly had not a single plan to offer.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui was starved of troops and pay, enemies ringed the province on every side, and Fu Ji could offer no workable plan at all.

sentences.zh: 翁同書亦據蒺終兇。

translations.literal: Weng Tongshu likewise clung to thorns and met calamity in the end.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Tongshu, too, clung to a perilous post and came to ruin.

sentences.zh: 嚴樹森恃才器小，效胡林翼而適得其反者也。

translations.literal: Yan Shusen relied on talent but his capacity was small; he imitated Hu Linyi and achieved the opposite result.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shusen was talented but small-minded; he tried to imitate Hu Linyi and achieved the opposite.
